prerequisites: Having acquired, at least partially, the learning objectives established in the subjects of Algorithmics, Databases, Programming Methodology, and Advanced Programming.

learning_outcomes.text: Students should know how to apply their knowledge to their work or vocation in a professional manner and possess the competences usually demonstrated through the elaboration and defense of arguments and problem-solving within their area of study.

Students should have the ability to gather and interpret relevant data (usually within their area of study) to make judgments that include a reflection on relevant social, scientific, or ethical issues.

Choose and apply the most appropriate methods and techniques to analyze and solve problems defined by data that represent a challenge due to their volume, velocity, variety, or heterogeneity, including computational, mathematical, statistical, and signal processing methods.

Possess experimental and analytical skills to work autonomously, being able to design experiments and describe, analyze, evaluate, and interpret the resulting information to propose alternative and novel solutions to known and/or emerging problems.
Create models and make decisions based on available data, combining acquired knowledge and being able to apply new knowledge for problem-solving.
Ability to integrate into a multidisciplinary team within the framework of a data science project.
Develop, manage, and lead projects that use the techniques, tools, and methodologies of data science in different application areas.
Identify opportunities for innovative data-oriented applications in continuously evolving technological environments.
Ability to express data processing results clearly and convincingly, both in writing and orally.
Use software engineering techniques for the management, analysis, design, and development of products that require intensive use of data.
Integrate into a software development team to build software according to client needs.
Understand the main process models and methodologies for software product development.
Analyze stakeholder needs and specify requirements, interacting effectively with the client.
Organize and distribute work within a team and monitor its progress.
Understand basic concepts of software quality and testing.
Perform effective tests on software components during their development.
Understand basic concepts of software configuration management.
Use version control tools during software development.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to Software Development Processes. Frameworks and Software Development Methodologies: Structured and agile. Scrum and Kanban.
Requirements Elicitation and Analysis. Representation and models. Functionality and data.
Introduction to Software Testing. Basic testing techniques.
Team development, for a given client, of a software product related to data storage, processing, and presentation to the user.

assessment_methods.method: Development of a software product (continuous evaluation of team project work)
Development of a software product (evaluation of individual contribution in reports, products, deliverables, and final presentation)
Attendance to at least 80% of face-to-face laboratory practice classes
Completion of tasks and activities on the virtual campus

assessment_rules: For ordinary examination, a minimum of 4 out of 10 points is required in the theory exam and in the software product development. If this requirement is met, the final grade is the weighted average of the theory exam (40%), software product development (40%), and attendance/participation (20%). If the minimum is not met, the final grade will be the weighted average with a maximum of 4 points. For extraordinary examination, the theory exam grade from the ordinary session (if 5/10 or higher) or a new written exam will be used. For software product development, the grade from the ordinary session (if 5/10 or higher) or an individual assignment will be used. Attendance and participation grade remains the same as in the ordinary session. A minimum of 5 out of 10 points is required in the theory exam and in the software product development. If this is not met, the final grade will be the weighted average with a maximum of 4 points.
